newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Chronology of Sunni-Shi'ite violence in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of Sunni-Shi'ite violence in Pakistan.

text.p: A bomb killed at least 19 people, including the leader of a militant Sunni Moslem group, and wounded 90 in what appeared to be the latest move in a long-running feud between Pakistan's Sunni and Shi'ite groups.
Here is a chronology of Sunni-Shi'ite violence since last year. Shi'ites form about 15 percent of the population of about 130 million, where the majority are Sunnis.
April 30: A local leader of the militant Sunni Sipah-i-Shahaba Pakistan (SSP), killed in Sheikhupura, in central province of Punjab.
May 26: Six Shi'ites killed, 12 wounded in ambush in Sardarey Wala village near Dera Ismail Khan in northwest.
June 20: At least 10 wounded by home-made bomb thrown at Shi'ite religious procession near Muzaffargarh in Punjab.
June 26: One killed, 16 wounded in Sunni-Shi'ite clashes in Mehrabpur in southern province of Sindh.
Aug 5: Gunmen kill the Commissioner of Sargodha Division, Syed Tajjamal Abbas, a Shi'ite, in Punjab.
Aug 14: Gunmen kill 12, wound 11 in an Independence Day attack on SSP cavalcade in Karachi.
Aug 18: Gunmen kill 18 people, wound dozens, in attack on Shi'ite community meeting near Mailsi, in Punjab.

Sept 10: Sunni-Shi'ite clashes erupt in the northwestern Kurram Agency border area where the government later said at least 97 people were killed and 89 wounded. But local newspaper reports put the death toll at up to 200.
Sept 12: Gunmen kill leader of the militant Shi'ite Sipah-i-Muhammad Pakistan (SMP), Murid Abbas Yazdani, at his home in Islamabad.
Sept 22: Gunmen kill a local SMP leader, Qamar Haider, at his shop in Bahawalpur, in Punjab.
Sept 23: Gunmen attack SSP-connected mosque in Multan, in Punjab, killing at least 20 worshippers and wounding many more.
Nov 30: Masked gunmen kill a Shi'ite lawyer in Lodhran district of Punjab province.
Dec 14: Gunmen kill a Shi'ite activist in Multan and wound two of his companions, one of whom later died.
Dec 31: Gunmen on motorcycles kill two Shi'ite activists and four others in ambushes of their vehicles in Lahore and Multan.
Jan 13: Gunmen kill a Shi'ite activist in Punjab's Multan city.
Jan 18: Bomb blast outside a Lahore court kills 19 people, including SSP leader Zia-ur-Rahman Faruqi, and wounding 90, including SSP deputy leader, Azim Tariq.
